podcast.body: Journey's "Don't Stop Believin'" was one of only four rock songs to appear in Spotify's top 100 most streamed songs of the 2010s. Its inclusion highlights the enduring appeal of classic rock tracks even amidst a decade dominated by pop and hip hop streaming. "Well, okay, there's journey and don't stop believing."
